inactivityDays.title: inactivityDays
inactivityDays.description: The minimum number of days since the last customer activity required for an Opportunity to qualify for outreach generation. Examples: If the user asks for opportunities with no activity for 14 or more days, set this value to 14. If the user specifies inactivity periods such as 7 days, 30 days, or 60 days, populate this value accordingly. Use Opportunity LastActivityDate to evaluate inactivity.

IsClosed.title: IsClosed
IsClosed.description: Check if the User is mentioning the Opportunity Closed or Open. if user specify Open then put Parameter as FALSE and if Closed then Put Parameter TRUE inside this Input.

renewalDays.title: renewalDays
renewalDays.description: The maximum number of days remaining until Contract End Date for Opportunities to qualify for bulk outreach generation. Examples: If the user asks for opportunities renewing within 30 days, set this value to 30. If omitted, use the default renewal threshold configured by the business process.
